per_seed_cluster_bootstrap.cluster_sampling: sample unique semantic IDs uniformly with replacement and retain all episodes in each sampled cluster
per_seed_cluster_bootstrap.statistic: episode-weighted paired mean within the resampled clusters

three_seed_summary.point_estimate: unweighted mean of the three model-seed paired deltas

hierarchical_bootstrap.procedure: sample three model seeds with replacement; within each selected seed sample semantic-ID clusters with replacement; average the three episode-weighted seed effects

gate.core_go_per_task: three-seed mean original-minus-strict tail accuracy >= 2.0 pp and all three seed deltas > 0
gate.overall_core_go: at least one task passes core_go_per_task
gate.strong_pattern: Sparse Disjunction mean delta >= 5.0 pp, absolute Conjunction mean delta <= 2.0 pp, and task mean deltas are nondecreasing from Conjunction to Majority to Sparse Disjunction

secondary_metrics.bce_direction_note: negative favors Original because lower BCE is better
secondary_metrics.original_exposure_stratification: descriptive seen-versus-unseen tail accuracy within each Original run

multiplicity.reason: The registered Gate is an effect-size and sign rule, not a null-hypothesis significance test; all task results and intervals are reported.

claim_rules.if_core_go: Allow a task-specific claim that the tested Transformer benefits from prior exposure to evaluation semantics.
claim_rules.if_no_go: Do not claim observed neural reliance on semantic exposure.
claim_rules.ranking_change: Forbidden unless the separately registered LSTM module is run and model ordering reverses between protocols.
